I would ask anyone who reads this comment to listen to his first album and understand the lyrics, that album is an unforgettable journey, it has been almost 20 years since it came out and I still remember everything from it. This has to be one of the best guests on lallantop. An educated and relaxed demeanor, speaks Urdu and Farsi with such grace, no ego, no attitude, loves his roots and is still connected to them. I am from Kapurthala, one of the 4 cities he mentioned in Doaba region in Panjab, we know about Sartaj, it's a privilege to come from the same area that gave birth to such a gem, we have been listening to him since 2007. He mentions Kapurthala in his song Filhaal, which he was talking about in this episode and it used to make me giggle as a child when the song came out but in actuality the song is so deep and so thought provoking. We're blessed that in a world of Karan Aujlas, Diljits and Moosewalas, we also have a humble sufi musician like Sartaj, I remember Sidhu used to be such a big fan of Sartaj too when he was alive. Your favourite artist's favourite artist. He needs to come back definitely.
